title: Tessa T
content: While waiting for traffic to clear so I could pull into our driveway, a van traveling 55 miles per hour slammed into our car without braking. The impact threw our car into oncoming traffic. Our seat backs broke which left our seats reclined while twisting and mangling us in the ordeal. On first impact, my husband and I both saw a flash of yellow. In my mind, I thought, “So, this is how I’m going to die.” When we were knocked forward, the car spun around, slinging me into the passenger door frame where I hit the airbag. I remember thinking, “Wow, that actually felt good, like a puffy cloud.” In reality, that impact left my whole arm black from bruising. The beginning of my experience was the flash of yellow and the soft hit of the door. I later found out that this was the moment we had the second 55 mph head-on impact from an extended cab truck that was much higher off the road than our car. In no way should the impact jolting us in the opposite direction at lightning speed have felt good to any living being. God had intervened at the moment of the yellow flash to spare my pain; this I know even though I did not see Him. When the truck hit us, it spun the car yet again to where the front was momentarily facing up our creek bed. When the car was in this position, it was as if time slowed way down. I felt and saw my spirit leave my body from my diaphragm area and shoot outward up the creek bed. I was analyzing this scene as it took a couple of seconds for me to realize that this was my spirit. It was bright yellow, almost white, and had a white glow all around it. From the back of my spirit, which I was looking at from my human eyes' perspective, there was a silver cord. This cord looked metallic but functioned like an elastic bungee cord. I was looking closely at this cord, as if the cord itself was a living being. Once I got a close look at it, I heard a loud zipping sound and saw the cord retract my spirit back into my body at near lightning speed. Then, I felt the third impact. We went nose down into the ten-foot-deep creek bed, which was excruciatingly painful. We then realized the truck had landed on top of our car, pinning us in the creek, where we stayed for an hour until rescuers cut us from the wreckage. My experience is so different from many other stories where people see their human body from above or outside of it looking back. I was right at the brink of death, but the silver cord held tightly to me and my spirit. Although the wreck was so intense it actually knocked my spirit out of my body. The G-forces our bodies sustained were so intense that we only had a 10% chance of surviving, yet we both did. We were injured extensively, but we lived to tell others about God’s grace.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Accident, Other (briefly specify), I am unsure. I believe I was as close to death as God would allow without fully dying.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.At what time during the experience were: Right at the moment the woman was about to slam into our vehicle and again at the point of the third impact.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, Time seemed to stop while I was gifted the ability to view the whole scene unfold.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I was confused about the entire process and had to take time to process what it all meant afterward due to pain and trauma from the wreck. My vision before was normal, and during the experience it was like being or heading to a different realm.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: What I heard was the zipping sound of the silver cord. That was loud. Normally I have 50% hearing loss in day-to-day life.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, I was the light; my spirit was radiant.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, Just the fact that my spirit was in my creek beside my house, which isn't where it belonged. The creek seemed slightly different, like it was the pathway to the everlasting.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: At first I felt confused, then analytical as I always am. Then I felt acknowledgment that my spirit was actually not inside my body any longer and barely hanging onto my earthly body by this silver cord, so amazement and puzzled all at the same time.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt no longer in conflict with nature
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Other Christian, I believe in God and had prayed occasionally but not as much as I wanted or needed to. I wasn't involved in church at the time, though I had previously attended regularly. I did watch some YouTube videos pertaining to Christianity, but not many.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I read the Bible more now, as well as other religious books. I also watch YouTube videos about the Bible.
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Other Christian, I have always believed strongly in God and that Jesus is the son of God who died on the cross to save us from our sins.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, This was a very fast response from God in saving us. It is actually astounding when one looks at the scene and facts. I never heard of the silver cord prior to my wreck. A doctor, three months post-accident, explained there is a church hymn talking about it, which prompted me to look in the Bible for answers. It is in there; I just hadn't seen it.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I feel as if I must share my story so others will know we are not just carnal beings that live to die; we live to LIVE again.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, I became aware that we are spirit beings and created beings at that. I know that I was on my way to be with God, so I don't think of it as mystical per se.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Uncertain, I knew I was entering a different realm, but I hadn't gone far enough to see into that realm yet.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Definitely an afterlife. I actually saw my spirit, which is unique in the fact that few get to do this. My spirit was headed out of my body toward something or somewhere, but it came back quickly.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes, After this experience my husband said to me, "I don't know how we survived that." I instantly had a vision of seven angels wing to wing in a circle around the front driver and passenger portion of our car with a look of determination on their faces. They were like an unbreakable chain around us, and once the danger was gone they were done with their job.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I felt love when my spirit was leaving.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, My husband and I are even closer, even though I didn't know that could be possible. My relationship with God has also changed, and He has my attention.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Knowing there is an Almighty God who cares deeply for us and has saved our lives more times than we will ever know, it is just sometimes we DO know. Being able to see my spirit, what it looks like (one side of it), what color it is, and how it attaches to the human body.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I have seen a couple of YouTube videos, although not the full video, and have read some things pertaining to them.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, I was in so much pain that it didn't compute with my brain until day three that this happened, and it was then that I remembered.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I haven't changed my view on the experience nor the reality of it. I don't make up imaginary stories and believe them; that would classify a certain kind of mental illness which I don't have.
